pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing games.

4. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

7. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Songs PERFORMING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Red, blue, and yellow

6. A — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — The speed of the music

9. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. A — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of AND RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Songs PERFORMING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
